summary: Read both pages, and where the reason hid, the Context companion, scroll, tuning ledger or SUBSTRATE's anatomy.json, for all 46 bare connects-to on the 2026-11-08 map, plus the four pair judgments from lint-link-pairs.py. The pattern tuning item 58 warned of held: about half the bare links had their reason somewhere other than a title on either page. It sat under display text (Trickster → FOUR PILLARS, Bessel → Spinoza Conatus as 'monism', Categorizing Inharmonicity → Compressor Design), in a Context companion (Pages as Agents → JEWEL and → Lateral Access, Palace Philosophies → 1 from 2, Cooperation Yields Agency → Quality Manifesto), in SUBSTRATE's anatomy (Endosymbiosis, Palace Enchantment, Lateral Access, Image Embedding Standard), or as the same equation or method written under another name (Dispersion ↔ Portamento's stiff-string B, Generative Compression ↔ the Blackboard's yellow-health compression). Three patterns repeat: the three bare Philosopher-visited pages take Floquet's existing visited-entry; the Shop's routing refusals become contrasts-with, as the Shop's other alternatives already are; and the cuts are mostly hub links that restate a more specific link one hop away (Adjacent Affordance → Stoicism via The Dichotomy of Control, Biomechanical → Granular via Neural Granular, Dialogue Moderator → STIGMERGY via BBS Blackboard), plus one whose reason was retired (Map Build → Harvest) and one pair that only shares a neighbour (Wallpaper Groups ↔ Quantum Synthesizer). Not settled: Shepard Tone → Frequency-Time Duality rests on one Risset sentence (low; cut it if a named sentence is required); Stoicism → Hyperdimensional Prism and Adjacent Affordance → Stoicism are the same kind of call made two ways, because Stoicism names the Prism and Adjacent Affordance never names Stoicism; the Founding Conversation retype to enables makes a lineage claim the coordinator may prefer as a plain label. Two things noticed outside the lane: Observable Plot → D3.js is enables[built-on], which reads backward (D3 enables Plot); and Bessel's 'monism' points at Spinoza Conatus rather than Spinoza. Nothing in the house was written.
